applies_why: The judge grounds UNDERDETERMINED on C4 pressing a dropped limb and no live link remaining, not on a single verse failing to state a link or its contrary.
quote: UNDERDETERMINED -- C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
why: K-S2 bars using a single verse's silence as a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, but this judge text uses the absence of a live link after the defender dropped that limb.
